maddeler.e:
أتزاحم (form VI)
# أَتَزَاحَمُ (ʔatazāḥamu) /ʔa.ta.zaː.ħa.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَزَاحَمَ (tazāḥama)
# أَتَزَاحَمَ (ʔatazāḥama) /ʔa.ta.zaː.ħa.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَزَاحَمَ (tazāḥama)
# أَتَزَاحَمْ (ʔatazāḥam) /ʔa.ta.zaː.ħam/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَزَاحَمَ (tazāḥama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
